purpose: Every source discovered during internet-wide VTU research, including those judged not useful, duplicate, inaccessible or rights-restricted.

sources.name: VTU B.E./B.Tech Regulations 2022 (22OB)
sources.notes: THE authoritative document for the 2022 scheme. Extracted locally with the repo pdfjs extractor.
verifiedFacts: 22OB 3.7 attendance 85% minimum
22OB 3.7 condonation up to 10%
DX = attendance below 75%
SGPA = SUM(Ci x Gi)/SUM(Ci) over all courses undergone
CGPA = SUM(Ci x Si)/SUM(Ci)
SGPA/CGPA rounded to 2 decimals
22OB 6.7 percentage M = CGPA x 10 (example 8.20 -> 82.0)
22OB 6.8 class equivalence FCD>=70, FC 60-70, SC 50-60, P 40-50
22OB 6.3 CIE max 50 min 40%; SEE max weightage 50 min 35%; overall pass 40%; min grade P (GP>=4)
Extra grades DX, AU, AB, PP, NP, IC, W
Table 1 Credit Values: L:T:P to credits mapping
Course types HS/BS/ES/SD(1-3)/AE(1-2)/NM(pass only)/PW 10/MP 3/IS 6 credits
NMC requires min 40% CIE and 75% attendance
Passing Standards: pass only when GP >= 4

sources.name: VTU CGPA Standard Formula page
verifiedFacts: Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) * 10 applies to 2015, 2017 and 2018 schemes ONLY

sources.name: VTU 2025 Scheme of Teaching and Examinations, I Sem Physics Group
sources.notes: Official 2025 scheme. Note the path is /pdf/UG2024/. 61 distinct 1B* codes. Table carries L:T:P:S, exam duration, CIE, SEE, Total, Credits. Codes use x as a stream placeholder (1BMATx101).
verifiedFacts: Effective from academic year 2025-26
Common to all Engineering Programmes
CIE 50 / SEE 50 / Total 100 on every parsed row
Credits observed 1-4
L:T:P:S columns present; S used by 1BPRJ258 (S=2)
Categories ASC, ESC, SDC, ETC, PLC(IC), AEC
